mock_difficulty.verdict: similar to the NEET-style reference form

college_reach.college_tier: Central Institutes (MAMC, VMMC, JIPMER, AIIMS Top 5)

mock_difficulty_tolerance_marks.kind: same tolerance as the equated-form gate

score_to_percentile_curve.basis: hand-set piecewise-linear anchors; NTA does not publish a full score-percentile table; year-to-year shifts of tens of marks are normal

assumptions.paper_year_scenarios: same marks re-read on the curve shifted by the difference in sourced general cut-off scores (2024-2026); an approximation, not a published distribution
assumptions.college_probabilities: normal approximation to the 90% score interval against approximate tier thresholds
assumptions.ability_basis: IRT 3PL with priors; no real student attempts exist yet to fit item parameters
assumptions.chapter_keys: Thermodynamics is one chapter key for Physics and Chemistry (known issue)
assumptions.chapter_marks_at_stake: each chapter assumes only that chapter reaches the target; the values are not additive

_note: SIMULATED student (true theta 0.8) on equated form 0; illustrative only, not a real student result
